digest.component_or_area: LLM provider infrastructure and runtime routing
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is hardcoded to Anthropic-specific behavior (provider string matching, cache gates, output mode selection) and lacks native Bedrock support, forcing clients to use inefficient OpenAI-compatible gateways that lose prompt caching and native structured output.
Config parsing for REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY exists but _pai_check_config refuses them at runtime, making documented env vars non-functional.
Adopted provider_factory hook from pydantic-ai to enable pluggable Provider construction and ModelProfile-driven capability detection, replacing hardcoded provider-name string matching.

Bedrock and direct Anthropic are first-class providers with equivalent retry/timeout guarantees via their respective transport layers; all other providers route through a single best-effort OpenAI-compatible builder.
Verdict sidecars must carry structured provenance (provider, model, endpoint, tier, capabilities) so consumers can distinguish first-class from best-effort verdicts.
Review bot must be migrated to Bedrock with no direct-Anthropic fallback and instrumented with CloudWatch alarms on client-error rates exceeding 25% over 15-minute windows.
